info.title: Factor Platform
info.description: 自然语言到可执行、可复现、可审计因子的研究平台

get.description:
Stream session events, resuming after ``Last-Event-ID`` when supplied.

``replay_only`` returns the backlog and closes, which is what a client that
just wants to catch up needs — and what makes this testable without a
connection that never ends.

post.description: Store a PDF, parse it, and attempt extraction.
Seed a normal workbench session from the server-side extraction record.

schema.title: Response List Factors Api Library Get

post.description: Evaluate a factor against forward returns.

Ambiguity.title: Ambiguity
Ambiguity.description: An unresolved choice persisted on a FactorSpec (e.g. missing rebalance).

AnnouncementTimingPolicy.title: AnnouncementTimingPolicy
AnnouncementTimingPolicy.description:
What to assume when the publication moment is unknown.

``conservative`` defers to the next session, which is the only choice that
cannot manufacture look-ahead.

ClarificationQuestion.title: ClarificationQuestion
ClarificationQuestion.description: A question presented to the user, possibly blocking further progress.

ComponentVersions.title: ComponentVersions
ComponentVersions.description:
Every version that can change the answer.

Long on purpose. Each of these has silently altered a factor's value in
systems like this, and a version nobody recorded is one nobody can rule out
when a rerun disagrees.

DataRequirement.title: DataRequirement
DataRequirement.description: A single logical variable needed by a factor, with its data semantics.

DataRules.title: DataRules
DataRules.description:
Universe and data-selection rules.

These were never transforms and are unaffected by ordering, so they stay as
plain switches. The transform switches that used to live alongside them now
belong to :class:`PreprocessingPipeline`.

Excerpt.title: Excerpt
Excerpt.description: One scored block, with the identifier the model must cite.

ExecutionPlan.title: ExecutionPlan
ExecutionPlan.description:
An ordered, fully-determined retrieval plan.

Carries its own ``time_convention`` rather than reading it back from the spec:
the plan is what gets signed, queued and replayed, so the timing rules that
decide when a signal is knowable have to travel with it.

ExecutionStep.title: ExecutionStep
ExecutionStep.description: One deterministic retrieval/computation step (tool + bounded arguments).

FactorSpec-Input.title: FactorSpec
FactorSpec-Input.description:
The confirmed, machine-checkable description of one factor.

``formula_ast`` is the single source of truth. ``canonical_formula`` is
rendered from it by the backend and is what the user actually confirms;
``formula_explanation`` is the model's prose and is display-only. The model
never authors the confirmed formula, so what is signed off and what is
executed cannot diverge.

FactorSpec-Output.title: FactorSpec
FactorSpec-Output.description:
The confirmed, machine-checkable description of one factor.

``formula_ast`` is the single source of truth. ``canonical_formula`` is
rendered from it by the backend and is what the user actually confirms;
``formula_explanation`` is the model's prose and is display-only. The model
never authors the confirmed formula, so what is signed off and what is
executed cannot diverge.

FieldCandidateBinding.title: FieldCandidateBinding
FieldCandidateBinding.description: A candidate tied to the logical variable it may satisfy in this session.

FieldSelection.title: FieldSelection
FieldSelection.description: A user-confirmed mapping from a logical variable to a concrete Wind field.

FieldTimeRole.title: FieldTimeRole
FieldTimeRole.description: How a field's timestamp is interpreted for point-in-time correctness.

FormulaExtraction.title: FormulaExtraction
FormulaExtraction.description: What was extracted, how sure we are, and what the user must do about it.

FormulaNode-Input.title: FormulaNode

FormulaNode-Output.title: FormulaNode

FramePayload.title: FramePayload
FramePayload.description: A date-indexed matrix in a JSON-friendly shape.

InformationAvailableTime.title: InformationAvailableTime
InformationAvailableTime.description: When a researcher could actually have known the value.

InputProvenance.title: InputProvenance
InputProvenance.description: What was read, from where, and what it looked like at the time.

ObservationTime.title: ObservationTime
ObservationTime.description: When the underlying datum is stamped.

PreprocessingPipeline.title: PreprocessingPipeline
PreprocessingPipeline.description: An ordered, duplicate-free sequence of transforms.

PreprocessingTarget.title: PreprocessingTarget
PreprocessingTarget.description:
What a step operates on.

``variables`` runs before the formula, once per raw input; ``factor`` runs
after the formula, on its single output. This distinction is precisely what
a boolean switch could not express.

ProvenanceRecord.title: ProvenanceRecord
ProvenanceRecord.description: The complete reproduction record for one published factor version.

QuantileReturns.title: QuantileReturns
QuantileReturns.description: Mean forward return per quantile, lowest factor value first.

ReportEvidence.title: ReportEvidence
ReportEvidence.description: A piece of source text that justifies an extracted value.

ResearchRequest.title: ResearchRequest
ResearchRequest.description: A user's natural-language research idea plus its evaluation envelope.

SeriesSummary.title: SeriesSummary
SeriesSummary.description: A metric series reduced to what a researcher reads first.

SessionSnapshot.title: SessionSnapshot
SessionSnapshot.description: The folded, current state of a session, fully derivable from its events.

TimeConvention.title: TimeConvention
TimeConvention.description:
The signal/trade timing contract carried by a spec, plan and artifact.

Defaults describe the首期 house convention: observe at the T close, treat it
as knowable only after that close, form the signal on T, trade at the T+1
open, and measure forward returns from that same open.

capability_note.title: Capability Note
capability_note.default: 首期支持正文可复制、变量定义明确的中英文文本型研报。图片公式、复杂数学排版与扫描版仅提取正文线索，公式需人工确认。
